purpose: Prospectively test whether the Phase379 target-reader-calibrated AI-smell discriminator can predict actual-human direction on genuinely fresh independent prose pairs before the human verdict, without using the discriminator as a generation prompt.

required_method.generation: Create a new frozen story-facts packet and two neutral, genuinely separate fresh generator invocations using the same facts and equivalent ordinary prose instructions. Neither generator may see Phase377/379 AI-smell taxonomies, prior human results, evaluator predictions, or the other output.
required_method.freeze: Fetch and byte-freeze both outputs before evaluation.
required_method.prediction: A separate evaluator applies rules/target-reader-ai-smell-discriminator-v1.md after freeze and seals a directional prediction before human review.
required_method.blind_review: Deterministically blind A/B ordering and ask the actual target reader to judge lower AI smell separately from overall preference, desire to continue, character naturalness, clarity/flow, and skim/stop urge.
required_method.adjudication: Reveal mappings only after human verdict; compare prediction direction to actual-human direction. Do not rewrite either output before verdict.

critical_design_change_from_phase378.reason: Phase378 PROCESS generation itself backfired. Phase380 tests discriminator calibration only, not a new writing recipe.

next_action: Prepare one new neutral fixed story-facts packet and two equivalent fresh generator invocation files. Do not generate prose in the current diagnosis/evaluator context.
